reports.summary: OVERVIEW Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan lay about 610 km south-southeast of Visakhapatnam at 5:30 am on 18 November, moving north-northwest at only about 3 km/h. It is forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh-Yanam coast between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon on 20 November, with winds of 100-110 km/h gusting to 120 km/h; earlier bulletins had expected a very severe cyclonic storm with winds of 145 km/h. Akvan is the third cyclone to strike this coast in 24 days, after Arnab (28 October) and Murasu (3 November). All 10 districts on red or orange alert were hit by those storms, seven of them by both.
